payload.summary: PRD exit test landed as tests/e2e/dispatch-handoff.test.ts: one CLI-driven dispatch of a 320KB brief proves all five clauses — bounded pointer argv (<4096B), byte-identical task.md with {run,item,responsibility,created}, a stub worker that parses both paths out of prompt prose alone and writes a conforming result.md, journaled task_doc/result_doc with a sentinel proving no task content anywhere in the journal, and validate exit 0 clean then warning [run.result-doc] on a bad status enum. No product defects found: all five clauses passed against the shipped children on the first run.

Red proof for a QA item on already-shipped code: mutation testing rather than a failing-first test. Three mutations against src/ were each caught and reverted — (a) renderTaskDoc truncating the body to 100KB (worker's own truncation guard failed the dispatch), (b) dispatch.started journaling ctx.args.task instead of taskDocRelativePath (sentinel assertion fired), (c) composeInvocation re-inlining 320KB into the prompt (argv bound assertion fired: expected <4096, received 321237). src/ verified clean afterward.
